narrative_purpose: Shows the phenetic trap in one image: grouped by overall look, the Na'vi falls beside a human; grouped by shared *derived* traits, the Na'vi nests deep among Pandoran hexapods. The reader sees why surface resemblance misleads and cladistic signal corrects it.
subject: A two-sided comparison plate. On the left, under a faint dim grouping arc, an upright human figure and an upright Na'vi figure stand side by side, their matching tall bipedal outlines glowing a misleading amber - a false pairing by looks alone. On the right, under a strong bright grouping arc, the same Na'vi figure stands instead among a cluster of Pandoran forms - a split-armed prolemuris, a six-limbed direhorse - the bond between them glowing true cyan-teal at a shared neck-braid feature, the real family.
scene: A dark specimen space split into two soft fields, the false grouping on the left in cool amber warning, the true grouping on the right in living teal.
camera: Front-on display view, the two groupings balanced left and right, the Na'vi figure echoed in both halves so the eye tracks its true home.
light: Bioluminescent self-glow: misleading amber on the human-Na'vi look-alike pairing, true cyan-teal on the Na'vi-prolemuris bond; deep indigo shadow throughout.
palette: Void-indigo ground; scarce amber for the false phenetic grouping, living-teal and cyan for the true cladistic one.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted texture, clear focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the Na'vi figure in both halves and on the two grouping bonds; the surrounding forms a touch softer; edges into haze.
composition: Balanced left-right diptych, the repeated Na'vi figure as the hinge, generous dark space above each grouping for later callouts.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette; amber strictly for the misleading look-alike grouping, teal for true kinship. Na'vi and prolemuris forms consistent with the chapter's other plates.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
